title: Contoso, Ltd.
sections:
Contoso, Ltd. is a manufacturing company that has 4,200 employees. The company has its headquarters in Chicago and branch offices in Montreal and Lisbon. Contoso recently acquired a spare-parts distributor that has 300 employees and uses the domain name contosoparts.com.

The IT department is consolidating the acquired company into the Contoso Microsoft 365 tenant and wants to standardize branding, billing, data protection, and monitoring across the combined organization.

**Tenant and identity**

- The tenant uses the initial domain contoso.onmicrosoft.com and the verified custom domain contoso.com, which is the default domain.
- All Contoso employees are assigned Microsoft 365 E5 licenses.
- A Microsoft 365 group named Sales-EU has 150 members. A security group named Exec contains the 40 members of the executive team.

**Acquired company**

- The contosoparts.com domain is registered at a registrar that does not support Domain Connect. The registrar also hosts the DNS zone.
- The 300 employees of the acquired company currently receive email through a third-party email provider.

**Licensing and billing**

- Contoso purchased 500 Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and assigned 420 of them.
- Members of Sales-EU do not have Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses. They use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
- An Azure subscription named Sub1 contains a resource group named RG-Billing.

**Administrators**

- Admin1 is assigned the SharePoint Administrator and Exchange Administrator roles and is a Contributor on Sub1.
- Admin2 is assigned the Billing Administrator role.

**Network**

- The Lisbon office routes all internet traffic through a proxy server in Chicago. A project to add local internet egress in Lisbon is planned for next year.

**Branding**

- The Contoso logo must appear in the Microsoft 365 suite header for all users.
- Members of Sales-EU must see a separate theme that uses the regional Sales logo.
- The Microsoft Entra sign-in page must show the Contoso background image.

**Acquired company**

- contoso.com must remain the default domain.
- Users of the acquired company must continue to receive email without interruption when their email moves to Exchange Online.

**Copilot**

- Sales-EU members must be able to use agents in Copilot Chat that ground on work data. The cost must be billed to Sub1, and the finance team must be alerted when spending reaches 80 percent of a monthly budget.
- Management wants to reclaim Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses from licensed users who have not used Copilot in the last 90 days. The IT department must identify these users by name.

**Data protection**

- The mailboxes and OneDrive accounts of the Exec group members must be protected by Microsoft 365 Backup, billed to Sub1.
- Mailbox restore points must be available for at least 18 months.
- OneDrive restore points must be available for at least five years.
- Backup storage costs must be minimized.

**Monitoring**

- The operations team members ops1@contoso.com and ops2@contoso.com must receive email notifications about incidents that affect Exchange Online and Microsoft Teams. They must not receive notifications about advisories.

- Follow the principle of least privilege.
- Do not assign the Global Administrator role to any additional user.
- Use built-in Microsoft 365 features and avoid custom scripts where possible.
